outcome_detail: Phase 3 SELVA met primary endpoint (mLM-IGA, p<0.001); 86% much/very much improved; NDA planned H2 2026
Phase 3 CYPRESS did not meet primary OHSA composite endpoint for ampreloxetine in nOH; program wound down, R&D org eliminated, strategic alternatives
NDA accepted with Priority Review; PDUFA July 17, 2026; VIKTORIA-1 PIK3CA wild-type Phase 3 data published in JCO (gedatolisib triplet PFS 9.3 vs 2.0 months, HR=0.24, p<0.0001)
